name: PublishStagedImportRun
request_type: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1<PublishStagedImportRunInternalV1> containing complete parser result + exact run/profile/checkpoint inputs defined by ticket_import.source_check job contract
transaction_boundary: bounded staging batches may commit while run remains unpublished validating; final publication/replay classification is one short UoW
authoritative_reads: complete unpublished observations/fields/findings and recomputed counts/fingerprint
guards: candidate remains exact stable source opened by job
validating rows remain non-authoritative until publication
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; internal command_id is generated by the durable-job handler for the exact publication operation and its semantic request hash binds job_id/import_run_id/expected run revision/profile versions/source candidate identity/logical fingerprint; committed replay returns the recorded publication result and changed semantic input under the same command_id is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
receipt_order: revalidate exact job/run state -> insert command_receipt -> guarded cleanup/publication writes -> audit/result -> commit
revision_effects: successful publication/noop state increments import_runs revision exactly once; failed/no-change does not
audit_action: ticket_import.run_published.v1 for published source evidence; exact replay/noop does not duplicate domain audit
post_commit_work: job continuation to review/noop checkpoint as dictated by committed state
